frontend: retro-run (writes saves as RetroArch does), via work/msx/make-save-x.py: content copied into the run directory
note: fMSX writes cartridge SRAM to <ROM path without extension>.sav beside the ROM (location content-dir), not in the save directory, on unload; RETRO_MEMORY_SAVE_RAM is not used for it, so RetroArch writes no .srm. system/CMOS.ROM is the MSX2+ RTC/CMOS, written into the system directory on unload.
